name: Large title navigation bar (iOS)
summary: A top-level iOS screen title shown large under the bar. As you scroll, the large title collapses into the small centered title.

anatomy.purpose: Compact bar that shows the small title after scrolling.
34pt bold title at the top of the content.

variants.name: Large title
variants.use: Top-level screens in a navigation stack (a flow of connected frames).

whenToUse: Root screens such as Inbox or Settings.
whenNotToUse: Detail screens: use a standard navigation bar.
Android: use a large top app bar.

keyboard: Tab to the scroll region; arrows scroll.
accessibility.focus: The scroll area is focusable so keyboard users can scroll.
notes: The large title is the heading (h1).
The small title is hidden from screen readers to avoid reading the title twice.
